label.description: The visible label, which also names the field. Without one, the field needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.

description.description: Supporting text shown with the field, which also describes it.

errorMessage.description: The message the field shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the field invalid by itself.

value.description: The time as HH:mm, when the caller controls it. HH:mm:ss and HH:mm:ss.fraction are accepted with their seconds ignored. null keeps a controlled field empty. Any other string throws a TypeError.

defaultValue.description: The starting time, when the field controls itself, in the formats value accepts.

minValue.description: The earliest time, inclusive, in the formats value accepts. A value before it stays visible and invalid. A minValue later than maxValue throws a TypeError.

maxValue.description: The latest time, inclusive, in the formats value accepts. A value after it stays visible and invalid.

disabled.description: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed.

readOnly.description: Makes the field read-only: its time stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

required.description: Marks the field required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is empty.

invalid.description: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the field invalid.

name.description: The form field name. A named field submits HH:mm, or an empty string while it is empty.

change.description: Called with the new time as HH:mm, or with null when the field is cleared.

MuxUITimeValue.description: A local clock time as an ISO string, `HH:mm`, with no date, time zone, or offset.
